solaris_resources.glyph_desc.convert_wat: Converts water sources within a 3x3x3 area centered on the target into Crystallized Water.
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.dissolve_wa: Dissolves Crystallized Water within a 3x3x3 area above the target into unstable Hydrogen and Oxygen atoms: 16 Hydrogen and 8 Oxygen per unit.
solaris_resources.glyph_name.assembly_at: Unstable Mana Atom Assembly Type I
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.assembly_at: Randomly assemble unstable hydrogen atoms within a 3×3×3 area above the target into unstable iron atoms, unstable carbon atoms, and unstable copper atoms.
solaris_resources.glyph_name.aggregation: Unstable Mana Atom Aggregation Type I
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.aggregation: Re-aggregate the unstable atoms within a 3×3×3 area above the target into elemental substances.
